recognition_trigger: When items must be grouped by equivalence regardless of character order, compute one complete canonical key for every item.
corrected_rule: Use the immutable 26-letter frequency tuple as the hashmap key and append each word to the corresponding bucket.
why_failed: The proposed invariant described what future words might do rather than the correctness state guaranteed for all words processed so far.
application: For tea, tan, ate, nat, and bat, compute each 26-count tuple; tea and ate share one bucket, tan and nat share another, and bat has its own bucket. After the first i words, every processed word appears exactly once in the bucket keyed by its complete tuple.
